item.title: Does JavaScript Really Lose to GPU? Three Real Benchmarks That Baffled Me
item.description: Particle simulation, matrix multiplication, image processing—real performance comparisons between WebGPU and JavaScript that yield surprising results. Not all scenarios need GPU; sometimes CPU does the job better.

item.title: Frontend Performance Optimization: I Replaced Axios With 25 Lines of Vanilla JS
item.description: Discovered that 13KB Axios is just a fetch wrapper. Using 25 lines of vanilla JS to achieve the same functionality while reducing bundle size by 92%. A real frontend performance optimization case.

item.title: Snapdom: A New Engine for Web Screenshots, Say Goodbye to Lag
item.description: Snapdom gained 2000+ stars in two months - how does it use SVG magic to make web screenshots lightning fast? Say goodbye to html2canvas lag and experience the modern web screenshot solution

item.title: Stop Using substr(): The Deprecated JavaScript API and the Right Replacements (slice vs substring)
item.description: substr() is deprecated and risky to rely on. This guide explains why, contrasts it with slice() and substring(), and provides a clear migration checklist and best practices.
